Title: Nab-paclitaxel plus S-1 versus nab-paclitaxel plus gemcitabine as first-line chemotherapy in patients with advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma: a randomized study
Author: Zong, Yuan; Yuan, Jiajia; Peng, Zhi; Lu, Ming; Wang, Xicheng; Shen, Lin; Zhou, Jun
Comment: The paper reports NO numeric hazard ratio, risk ratio, log[HR], SE, or 95% CI for overall survival anywhere in the text — only median OS (10.2 vs 10.2 months) and a log-rank P value (0.92), with Kaplan–Meier curves (Fig. 3) and an untranscribed subgroup forest plot (Fig. 4). Per the synthesis plan's effect-size note, this study is NOT usable for a Cox-model RR for overall survival; no HR was approximated from counts. No number of deaths per arm is reported. Medians are reported without IQR or range, so no dispersion could be extracted. Trial was prematurely closed after 40 of 110 planned patients (underpowered).; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Nab-paclitaxel plus S-1 (nab-P/S), 125 mg/m2 IV day 1 + S-1 orally BID days 1-7 every 2 weeks') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False); unsupported or insufficient statistic type
Design Type: randomized controlled trial (phase II, single-center, open-label, 1:1, ITT)
domain: clinical oncology / advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
Participant type: Treatment-naïve adults (≥18 years) with histologically/cytologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, ECOG PS 0–1
Recruitment source: Department of Gastrointestinal Oncology, Peking University Cancer Hospital & Institute (Beijing Cancer Hospital), August 2018 – June 2019
Outcome measurement: Median overall survival in months; log-rank P value (no hazard ratio or 95% CI reported)
effect_direction: null/no difference (median OS 10.2 vs 10.2 months, p=0.92)

Report_ID: Overall survival (median OS and hazard ratio for death)
Title: Sequential nab-paclitaxel/gemcitabine followed by modified FOLFOX for first-line metastatic pancreatic cancer: The SEQUENCE trial
Author: Carrato et al.
Comment: Conference abstract; HR reported for overall survival with 95% CI but the model (presumed Cox proportional hazards) is not explicitly named. Median OS values are medians with 95% CIs (not IQR/range), placed in median + CI fields. The same ratio was entered in both hazard_ratio and the general risk_ratio bucket as requested by the synthesis plan.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('nab-P/Gem-mFOLFOX (nab-paclitaxel + gemcitabine followed by modified FOLFOX-6)') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Participant type: adults with untreated metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
Outcome measurement: Median OS in months with 95% CI, and hazard ratio with 95% CI
Outcome variable: Overall survival (median OS and hazard ratio for death)

Title: Gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel until progression or alternating with FOLFIRI.3, as first-line treatment for patients with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma: The Federation Francophone de Cancerologie Digestive-PRODIGE 37 randomised phase II study (FIRGEMAX)
Author: Rinaldi et al. (Taieb)
Comment: Trial was explicitly non-comparative; HR and 95% CI were "carried out for exploratory purposes" and no p-value was reported. The same HR/CI values were entered in both the hazard_ratio and the general-purpose risk_ratio buckets (the review's plan treats the Cox HR as the RR for pooling) — they represent ONE estimate, not two.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Arm A (FIRGEMAX): gemcitabine + nab-paclitaxel alternating with FOLFIRI.3') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Participant type: chemotherapy-naive adults (18-75 y) with histologically/cytologically proven metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma, WHO PS 0-2
Outcome measurement: Median OS in months and hazard ratio with 95% CI
effect_direction: slightly favours fluoropyrimidine-based (alternating FOLFIRI.3) arm but non-significant (HR 0.92, 95% CI 0.62-1.36)

Report_ID: Overall survival (time to death from any cause)
Title: NALIRIFOX versus nab-paclitaxel and gemcitabine in treatment-naive patients with metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (NAPOLI 3): a randomised, open-label, phase 3 trial
Author: Wainberg ZA, et al.
Comment: Hazard ratio is from a stratified Cox model with nab-paclitaxel+gemcitabine as reference; HR<1 favours NALIRIFOX. HR also recorded in the generic ratio (risk_ratio) bucket as requested by the plan. Medians are Kaplan-Meier estimates with 95% CIs, not means/SDs; no SD available.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('NALIRIFOX (liposomal irinotecan + oxaliplatin + leucovorin + fluorouracil)') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Country: Multinational (187 sites in 18 countries: Europe, North America, South America, Asia, Australia)
Participant type: Adults (>=18 years) with previously untreated metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, ECOG performance status 0-1
Recruitment source: 187 community and academic oncology centres in 18 countries
Outcome measurement: Median overall survival (Kaplan-Meier) and stratified Cox proportional hazards ratio
Outcome variable: Overall survival (time to death from any cause)

Report_ID: Overall survival (median OS; exploratory univariate Cox hazard ratio)
Title: Nab-paclitaxel plus either gemcitabine or simplified leucovorin and fluorouracil as first-line therapy for metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma (AFUGEM GERCOR): a non-comparative, multicentre, open-label, randomised phase 2 trial
Author: Bachet et al.
Comment: Trial was explicitly non-comparative; no formal statistical comparison between arms was planned and the HR is labelled "exploratory" from univariate Cox analysis only. Median OS CI for the fluoropyrimidine arm differs between Results text (8.8-16.5) and Table 2 (8.8-15.4); the Results-text value is recorded. HR 0.61 (0.40-0.95) recorded in both hazard_ratio and the general ratio (risk_ratio) buckets per the synthesis plan's instruction to treat the Cox HR as the RR — these are the same single estimate, not two results.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Simplified leucovorin and fluorouracil plus nab-paclitaxel (nab-paclitaxel 125 mg/m2 days 1, 8, 15; leucovorin 400 mg/m2 and fluorouracil 400 mg/m2 bolus then 2400 mg/m2 over 46 h on days 1 and 15)') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Participant type: previously untreated adults (>=18 years) with pathologically confirmed metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma, ECOG PS 0-2
Recruitment source: 15 hospitals and institutions in France (GERCOR network)
Outcome measurement: Median overall survival in months with 95% CI and exploratory hazard ratio with 95% CI
Outcome variable: Overall survival (median OS; exploratory univariate Cox hazard ratio)

Title: Nab-paclitaxel plus gemcitabine with or without capecitabine and cisplatin in metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PACT-19): a randomised phase 2 trial
Author: Reni et al.
Comment: Trial was a calibrated phase 2 design with no formal planned efficacy comparison; the HR for death is from an exploratory time-to-event analysis (log-rank/Kaplan-Meier). The unadjusted HR 0.60 (0.39-0.95) was extracted as the primary reported estimate; an exploratory multivariable-stratified HR for death of 0.58 (0.36-0.96, p=0.03) is also reported. The hazard ratio was also entered into the risk_ratio/CI fields per the synthesis plan's request for the paper's own time-to-event ratio estimate.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('PAXG (cisplatin, nab-paclitaxel, gemcitabine + oral capecitabine)') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Participant type: adults aged 18-75 years with pathologically confirmed stage IV pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, chemotherapy-naive, Karnofsky performance status >=70
Recruitment source: San Raffaele Hospital, Milan, Italy (single centre)
Outcome measurement: Hazard ratio for death with 95% CI; median overall survival in months; deaths/n
effect_direction: favours capecitabine-containing PAXG regimen (HR for death 0.60, 95% CI 0.39-0.95)
